errors.text_span: der Füllstand im Januar bei etwa 80 % beginnt und im März auf etwa 10 % fällt
errors.evidence: Description incorrectly states that the filling level starts at 80% in January and falls to 10% in March when the figure shows values starting between 60-80% and dropping to around 15-60%.
The description does not mention the highlighted note indicating the current filling level of 37%.
The description does not include information about the gray lines representing the entire timeframe from 2011 to 2019.
Description refers to the line for 2020 as purple, while it is actually pink.
Description incorrectly states that the line for 2021 is violet, when it is actually represented in dark green.
The description does not explicitly state the purpose of the chart, which is to illustrate gas storage levels and commitments in Germany.
